statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-42766 ("Possible NULL Dereference in Password-Based CMS Decryption", Low): a specially crafted password-encrypted CMS message can make CMS decryption dereference a NULL pointer, crashing the application. OpenSSL fixed it in 3.5.7 (https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260609.txt; fix on the openssl-3.5 branch: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/056d06c1918fafbb98c1c85a02e4c47cc4e199ce, committed after OpenSSL 3.5.6). Alpine lists it fixed in openssl 3.5.7-r0 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-42766). The advisory states that the OpenSSL FIPS modules are not affected because the code is outside the FIPS module boundary. The DHI Alpine 3.23 openssl packages (origin openssl: libcrypto3, libssl3, openssl and its -dbg, -dev, -doc, -libs-static and -misc packages in the DHI Alpine repository, and openssl-fips in the DHI security repository) are published as 3.5.4-r0, 3.5.5-r0, 3.5.5_git20260330-r1, 3.5.6-r0, 3.5.6-r1, 3.5.7-r0, 3.5.7-r1, 3.5.8-r0, 3.5.8-r1, 3.5.9-r0, 3.5.9-r1 and 3.5.9-r2 (openssl-fips from 3.5.5_git20260330-r1 on), each for x86_64 and aarch64. The OpenSSL version string in libcrypto.so.3 (libcrypto3) and in fips.so (openssl-fips) of every build, read from packages verified against the index checksums, is the OpenSSL release in the package version. Every build before 3.5.7-r0, including 3.5.5_git20260330-r1, whose libcrypto reports OpenSSL 3.5.5, is based on OpenSSL 3.5.6 or older without the fix, and 3.5.7-r0 and every later build are based on OpenSSL 3.5.7 or later.

CVE-2026-42766 ("Possible NULL Dereference in Password-Based CMS Decryption", Low): a specially crafted password-encrypted CMS message can make CMS decryption dereference a NULL pointer, crashing the application. OpenSSL fixed it in 3.5.7 (https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260609.txt; fix on the openssl-3.5 branch: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/056d06c1918fafbb98c1c85a02e4c47cc4e199ce, committed after OpenSSL 3.5.6). Debian fixed it for trixie in openssl 3.5.6-1~deb13u2 (DSA-6335-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-42766. The advisory states that the OpenSSL FIPS modules are not affected because the code is outside the FIPS module boundary. The DHI Debian 13 openssl packages are rebuilds of Debian's trixie openssl, published in the DHI Debian repository and the DHI security repository (the FIPS builds and the openssl-provider-fips package of every build only in the security repository). The Debian changelog shipped in libssl3t64 was read from every published build on amd64 and arm64 (25 versions, packages verified against the index checksums). No build of Debian 3.5.5-1~deb13u2 or 3.5.6-1~deb13u1, FIPS builds included, names CVE-2026-42766; the first published rebuild of Debian 3.5.6-1~deb13u2 and every later build, FIPS builds included, carry Debian's 3.5.6-1~deb13u2 entry naming it. The openssl-provider-fips package, read from every build on both architectures, ships the OpenSSL 3.1.2 FIPS provider in the FIPS builds and the FIPS provider from the same OpenSSL release (3.5.5, 3.5.6, 3.5.7 or 3.5.9) in the other builds. The range ends at the first rebuild of Debian 3.5.6-1~deb13u2.
